stable.title: PlayDeck 0.4.6
stable.summary:
• Component downloads now survive backgrounding. Proton, desktop, Turnip driver, and Decky Loader installs are wired through the foreground BackgroundDownloadService, so starting a download and switching to another app no longer kills it. Downloads show a progress notification and verify checksums before installing.
• Release signing works again. The build's sign step now receives the release key (secrets: inherit was missing on the reusable sign workflow call), so signed APKs are produced for all four variants.
• CI cleanup. Dropped the announce/catalog jobs, which published to the upstream Droid-Deck CI app that doesn't exist in this fork and always failed.
